description: This file contains an extension of the VoiceWakeOverlayController class, implementing various methods related to managing voice recognition overlay sessions, including starting sessions, updating partial transcripts, presenting final results, handling user editing, sending data, dismissing the overlay, updating levels, and auxiliary functions for token validation and attributed string creation.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Initializes and begins a new voice overlay session with provided parameters, updating internal state and UI accordingly.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current session's token, source, transcript text, and visibility status as a tuple.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the overlay with a partial transcript, ensuring token validity and overlay is not final, adjusting UI and state.

methods.name: presentFinal
methods.description: Displays the final transcript, optionally schedules auto-send after a delay, adjusts UI, and handles auto-send logic.

methods.name: userBeganEditing
methods.description: Marks the beginning of user editing, cancels auto-send, and updates UI state.

methods.name: cancelEditingAndDismiss
methods.description: Cancels user editing, dismisses the overlay, and resets relevant UI state.

methods.name: endEditing
methods.description: Ends user editing mode without dismissing the overlay.

methods.name: updateText
methods.description: Updates the overlay's transcript text and UI based on user input.

methods.name: beginSendUI
methods.description: Changes UI to indicate sending state, plays optional chime, and schedules overlay dismissal.

methods.name: requestSend
methods.description: Requests to send the current transcript via the shared session coordinator.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the overlay with animated UI changes, resets state, and triggers post-dismiss actions based on the outcome.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the visual level indicator for the current session, respecting rate limits.

methods.name: evaluateToken
methods.description: Static method to compare active token with incoming token, determining acceptance or mismatch.

methods.name: scheduleAutoSend
methods.description: Schedules an automatic send after a specified delay, with cancellation handling.

methods.name: makeAttributed
methods.description: Creates an attributed string from plain text with default styling.
